Docs.TitleHtml: Sec. 50-17-1. - Created; boundaries established; zoning classifications depicted.
Docs.Title: Sec. 50-17-1. - Created; boundaries established; zoning classifications depicted.
Docs.Content:
In accordance with the Zoning Enabling Act of Michigan, Public Act 207 of 1921, as amended by Public Act 306 of 1941, on December 25, 1940, the City of Detroit enacted a zoning ordinance, which included 79 zoning district maps. This article contains Zoning District Maps Nos. 1 through 78, whose boundaries were established on, and remain unaltered since, December 25, 1940. Each map depicts current zoning classifications. The history notes, which follow each map, delineate the ordinances that established and amended each map.
